headline: Is Aflac (AFL) Still Reasonable After A 143% Five Year Run?
summary: Aflac stock has delivered a strong 142.8% return over the past five years, yet current valuation checks send mixed signals, with the Excess Returns intrinsic value estimate pointing to upside while earnings based multiples lean the other way. A 142.8% gain over five years puts Aflac among the stronger long term performers, which raises the bar for any further upside from today's price. The share price can be supported if the company continues to convert earnings into steady cash flows...
